description: Express service: reflected XSS, eval, command injection, an unchecked object reference and a baked-in signing secret. Hermetic fixture.

vulnerabilities.description: Query parameter is concatenated into an HTML response without encoding.
Query parameter is concatenated into a command passed to child_process.exec.
The order is returned for any id with no check that it belongs to the caller.
vulnerabilities.note: Business-logic flaw: no pattern-based scanner is expected to find it.

vulnerabilities.description: JWT signing secret is a string literal in the source.
